details.failure_summary: Known product defect #2055 - agent icon immediate-vs-persisted link assertion fails per tracked issue
details.reasoning: The failure message explicitly states this is a 'known isolated product defect https://github.com/EliteaAI/elitea-testing-public/issues/2055, not test/infrastructure'. The test's soft assertion framework reports failure because the guard condition for issue #2055 is active. All other assertions (PUT 200, persistence after reload, Save-stays-disabled, exact-URL match on dashboard card) passed. This is a deliberate, tracked product bug — not a flaky test or infrastructure issue — and should be treated as a known pattern until issue #2055 is resolved.
